subject.title: Telegram should default to allowlist mode with owner ID

question: Should fresh Telegram setup move to token-verified owner capture that writes dmPolicy="allowlist" and allowFrom by default, or should pairing remain the omitted-policy default with stronger setup/docs warnings?
rationale: This chooses the first-run trust boundary for who can request access to a private Telegram bot and changes the compatibility expectations for omitted Telegram dmPolicy.

options.title: Adopt verified owner capture
options.body: Fresh Telegram setup displays a random token, accepts only the sender who sends that token, and stores allowlist mode for that numeric owner by default.

options.title: Keep pairing default
options.body: Pairing stays the default while setup and docs more strongly guide one-owner deployments to manual numeric allowlists.

options.title: Fold into broader bootstrap design
options.body: Keep this issue as context while a broader bootstrap or post-bootstrap-default issue defines the permanent product contract.

recommendation.title: Adopt verified owner capture
recommendation.body: Fresh Telegram setup displays a random token, accepts only the sender who sends that token, and stores allowlist mode for that numeric owner by default.
